q: The Karchmer-Wigderson theorem relates circuit depth complexity to:
opts: The communication complexity of the Karchmer-Wigderson game for f
exp: Karchmer-Wigderson: the depth of a Boolean circuit for f equals the communication complexity of the game where Alice has x ∈ f⁻¹(1), Bob has y ∈ f⁻¹(0), and they must find a coordinate i where x_i ≠ y_i. This reduces circuit lower bounds to communication lower bounds.
